headline: Lecco works more than anyone in Italy, but it doesn't show in salaries
summary: Lecco ranks first in Italy for paid working days and sixth for salary. Its daily pay tells a different story from the number of days worked.
why: Regional wage and labour-market data show differences in productivity and pay across Italian provinces. Such gaps matter for local consumer spending and labour costs.
